title: Applied ML Engineer, Computer Vision and Platform
summary: Senior IC on the AI team, owning product roadmap and client interface at a safety-critical monitoring company.

engagements.name: NABORS, drilling
points: Led client interaction with the operations teams and owned delivery end to end: product design, development, architecture, AI and hardware installation.
Designed an after-action review product for rig operations from requirements to Figma, then built its frontend and backend.
Drove the target architecture of the vision platform: site-scoped rules, an edge runtime that closes the loop with no cloud link, and a cloud control plane. 43 requirements traced to design.
Fine-tuned detection models for PPE monitoring and wired alert emission into the platform.
Installed and commissioned cameras, recorders and edge boxes at the rig.

engagements.name: SATORO, maritime
points: Ran roadmap and delivery for a vessel-based monitoring line: onboard detection, a bridge application for the crew, and shore-side data services.
Delivered person and vessel detection running live inference on onboard video.

engagements.name: Core engineering
points: Led the architecture of a real-time GPU vision pipeline on DeepStream and TensorRT. The Legolas edge runtime adds about 31 MB per extra FHD camera.
Deployed LLM-based validation of safety-equipment alerts that cut false positives by over 95%.
Delivered an end-to-end oil-spill crisis-management platform: instance segmentation, object detection and an operations interface on AWS.
Analysed 67,000 railway alert thumbnails: 21 of 119 camera scenes produced 92% of false alerts.
Onboarded 10+ engineers and run a multi-agent engineering workflow daily.

engagements.name: Electoral-analytics platform
points: Built the whole backend: FastAPI over public electoral and census data in BigQuery, PostgreSQL, JWT authentication, Docker and GCP deployment. About 175 commits.

title: Product Analyst, then People Analytics Intern

engagements.name: People and HCM product
points: Prioritised system fixes from ticket trends and cut ticket volume by 10% in a year.
Automated HCM data distribution from a week of manual work to immediate, with LGPD-compliant access control.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst and Commercial Department
summary: KPI reports on client return on investment, and investor relations for a fund manager.
